freshnessIssues.text: The official party-position table is explicitly dated 11 September 2025 (59 occupied seats), while the directory captured 20 October 2026 lists 58 members and two vacant entries. Do not combine these into one undated current tally.

The Singjamei member profile career note still lists earlier ministerial portfolios. It is not used as a current-office record; the dated 2026 swearing-in announcement and current NEC directory are separately cited.

method: All 60 official directory entries and profile party labels checked by machine extraction. Education and career notes are attributed profile text; not an independent qualification audit or an assertion that the final career role is current.
